async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    for name in ("modal", "harmonic", "buckling"):
        result = await sim.run(tasks[name])
        await sim.record(name, result["artifacts"][name])
        if name == "buckling":
            await sim.record("bucklingFactor", result["artifacts"]["bucklingFactor"])
        sim.release(result["artifacts"])
        sim.release(result["state"])
    state = None
    for step in range(3):
        result = await sim.run(tasks["transient"], state=state)
        if step > 0:
            sim.release(state, keep=result["state"])
        state = result["state"]
        if step == 2:
            await sim.record("transient", result["artifacts"]["history"])
            await sim.record("transientAnimation", result["artifacts"]["displacementHistory"])
            await sim.record("transientMesh", result["artifacts"]["displacement"])
        sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    return state
